title: RadhaKrishna Apt.
subtitle: Where Living is Enjoyment
address: Plot No. 8, Dholvira Navli Road, Near Sai Baba Temple, Palghar (East) – 401404
shortDescription: Premium G+7 residential building offering meticulously designed 1BHK and 2BHK homes in the heart of Palghar East.
description:
RadhaKrishna Apt. by Arihant Infra is a landmark G+7 storey residential building offering premium 1BHK and 2BHK homes in the heart of Palghar (East). Every specification, every finish — chosen for lasting quality and refined living.

Strategically positioned near the railway station with full Palghar Municipal Council sanction, major bank loan approvals, and RCC earthquake-resistant construction — this is a home that's built on trust.

The building features two retail shops on the ground floor, providing residents with convenient access to daily services. From the 1st floor upwards, each level is dedicated to premium residential units, with panoramic views growing more spectacular with every floor.

title: Arihant Residency
subtitle: Timeless Homes for Modern Families
shortDescription: A landmark residential complex featuring spacious 1BHK and 2BHK apartments with world-class amenities in central Palghar.
description:
Arihant Residency stands as a testament to Arihant Infra's commitment to quality and excellence. This completed project delivered 48 premium residential units across 6 floors, each designed with meticulous attention to detail.

Located on the bustling Station Road, residents enjoy unmatched connectivity — just a 5-minute walk to Palghar Railway Station. The complex features a landscaped garden, children's play area, and dedicated parking for all residents.

All units were handed over with RERA compliance and within the promised timeline, reflecting our philosophy of putting homebuyers first.

title: Krishna Heights
subtitle: Elevated Living, Elevated Life
shortDescription: A premium G+5 tower offering beautifully crafted 2BHK apartments with panoramic views and top-tier amenities.
description:
Krishna Heights was conceived as an urban sanctuary — a place where modern design meets the tranquility of nature. The G+5 structure houses 30 exclusive 2BHK apartments, each offering sweeping views of the Palghar landscape.

This project was a milestone for Arihant Infra — introducing earthquake-resistant RCC construction, concealed wiring, and branded fixtures as standard across all units, setting a new benchmark for residential construction in the region.

Delivered on schedule and fully compliant with all regulations, Krishna Heights remains a proud jewel in our portfolio.

title: Arihant Enclave
subtitle: The First Chapter of Excellence
address: Plot No. 3, Sarpamala Road, Near Bus Stand, Palghar – 401404
shortDescription: The flagship project that established Arihant Infra's legacy — 24 homes delivered with zero compromise on quality.
description:
Arihant Enclave is where our story began. This G+4 residential project was the first major development by Arihant Infra, and it set the tone for every project that followed: meticulous quality, transparent dealings, and homes that truly last.

Located near the Palghar Bus Stand, Arihant Enclave offered affordable yet premium 1BHK homes to first-time homebuyers. The project was fully sold out within 6 months of launch and handed over on schedule.

The success of Arihant Enclave laid the foundation for our growing legacy in the Palghar real estate market.
